narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I know. You add three to end on three, instead of adding four.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it with five. Ten, then thirteen, then halve to six and a half, then take away five.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That leaves one and a half, not three. The halving cut the three in half.
